notes: Rebuilds the Editor controls around stylized rectangular section tabs on the left: Background / Header, Text, Images / GIFs, Panels / Boxes, Text Boxes / Inputs, Required Tag Grid, Preview, and Export. Background and Header are intentionally combined and there is no separate Footer category. Text is reorganized into Title, Author, Tags (including warnings and category), Summary / Main Text, Notes, Stats, and Interface. Every text group now has Font, Size, Color, Bold, Italic, Letter Spacing, and Text Shadow / Glow controls, with matching live preview CSS and exported AO3 CSS. Keeps browser-style workspace tabs and multi-skin document tabs.
